title: Long continuous sitting reminder
sensor_condition: A validated future rule reports continuous sitting for its configured duration; no duration is assumed here.
intervention: offer an optional brief movement or position-change reminder
preserve the study goal and let the user dismiss the reminder
missing_data_behavior: Ignore the sensor condition and keep the normal timer-based plan.
contraindications: do not infer injury, pain, or a medical condition from sitting duration

title: Sustained left-lean observation
sensor_condition: Confirmed direction semantics and a validated future rule report a sustained left-lean observation.
intervention: offer a neutral optional position-change reminder
avoid describing the observed direction as harmful or incorrect
missing_data_behavior: Apply no posture adjustment and continue the non-sensor schedule.
contraindications: do not diagnose asymmetry or prescribe corrective posture

title: Sustained forward-lean observation
sensor_condition: Confirmed direction semantics and a validated future rule report a sustained forward-lean observation.
intervention: offer an optional comfort-oriented position change
keep wording neutral and non-diagnostic
missing_data_behavior: Apply no posture adjustment and continue the non-sensor schedule.
contraindications: do not label the reading as evidence of harm or injury

title: Pressure imbalance observation
sensor_condition: Confirmed calibration and channel semantics report a pressure imbalance under an approved future rule.
intervention: offer a neutral optional repositioning reminder
do not infer the body direction or a health consequence from the value
missing_data_behavior: Ignore the pressure field and use the normal timer-based plan.
contraindications: do not invent pressure units, thresholds, calibration, or medical meaning

title: Repeated posture-change observations
sensor_condition: Validated future processing reports repeated direction changes within a confirmed observation window.
intervention: avoid repeated alerts
offer at most the configured neutral check-in and preserve user control
missing_data_behavior: Do not count changes and continue the normal timer-based plan.
contraindications: do not interpret movement frequency as agitation, pain, or illness

title: Missing sensor readings fallback
sensor_condition: One or more expected sensor fields are absent from an otherwise accepted input.
intervention: ignore missing fields
continue the complete non-sensor study and break schedule
explain that no sensor adjustment was applied
missing_data_behavior: The fallback is the normal timer-based plan with no inferred replacement value.
contraindications: do not impute a posture state or pressure value

title: Stale sensor readings fallback
sensor_condition: A confirmed timestamp rule marks the latest sensor observation as stale.
intervention: ignore the stale observation
continue the normal timer-based schedule
show a non-alarming data-status explanation
missing_data_behavior: Treat stale data as unavailable and make no sensor-based adjustment.
contraindications: do not reuse the last posture state as if it were current

title: Invalid sensor readings fallback
sensor_condition: Schema, range, or consistency validation rejects one or more sensor fields under the confirmed hardware contract.
intervention: ignore invalid fields
preserve the non-sensor plan
record a validation status without a health interpretation
missing_data_behavior: Use no sensor adjustment unless another independently valid field has an approved rule.
contraindications: do not clamp invented hardware ranges or guess a corrected reading

title: Disconnected sensor fallback
sensor_condition: The application receives a confirmed disconnected status or receives no valid sensor connection state.
intervention: continue all normal timer-based planning
show an optional connection-status message
do not block studying
missing_data_behavior: Operate exactly in non-sensor mode until a later valid connection is confirmed.
contraindications: do not infer why the device disconnected

title: User-dismissed reminder handling
sensor_condition: The user dismisses or declines a non-medical movement or position-change reminder.
intervention: respect the dismissal
avoid immediate repeated prompts
continue the current plan unless the user chooses a change
missing_data_behavior: Reminder dismissal does not require sensor data; preserve the current plan.
contraindications: do not shame the user or state that dismissal causes harm

title: Safe timer-based break fallback
sensor_condition: Sensor mode is unavailable, disabled, missing, stale, invalid, or not supported by a confirmed rule.
intervention: use the selected session template's bounded break proposal
allow ordinary user-controlled breaks and task changes
state that sensor data was not used
missing_data_behavior: This record is the default safe behavior for every unavailable-sensor case.
contraindications: do not claim the timer prevents injury or is scientifically optimal

title: Concerning symptom safety boundary
sensor_condition: The user reports concerning symptoms or asks the sensor to diagnose pain, numbness, injury, or a medical condition.
intervention: state that the planner and sensor cannot diagnose or treat symptoms
stop sensor-based posture optimization for the request
encourage the user to seek appropriate qualified help when they are concerned
missing_data_behavior: Sensor availability does not change this safety boundary.
contraindications: do not provide a diagnosis, treatment, exercise prescription, or emergency assessment
